searchTerms.title: Search terms
searchTerms.description: Keywords searched in both stores, for example habit tracker or vpn. Each store returns its results in its own order (rank).

appIds.title: Apps
appIds.description: Google Play package names or links (com.habitnow) and App Store ids or links (apps.apple.com/us/app/.../id1234567890). Each app is also looked up in the other store.

charts.title: Top charts
charts.description: Top charts of both stores (all apps).

chartDepth.title: Chart depth
chartDepth.description: Apps per chart and store (up to 100).

countries.title: Countries
countries.description: Two-letter country codes, for example US, GB, DE, TH. Each country is a separate store front.

language.title: Language (Google Play)
language.description: Language of Google Play texts, for example en, de or th.

maxItemsPerSource.title: Results per search
maxItemsPerSource.description: Apps per search term and store.

playDetails.title: Full Google Play details
playDetails.description: Open every Google Play app page for ratings count, release and update dates, version and description (slower). Off: the search and chart data only.

maxItems.title: Max apps
maxItems.description: Stop after this many apps in total. 0 for no limit.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy
proxyConfiguration.description: The Actor connects directly and switches to Apify Proxy by itself if a store limits requests.
